You don't have to sit staring at a blank page wondering what digital product to create. You can use ChatGPT to help you work through the process, step by step. Try these 7 prompts: 1. Find a product idea "Act as a digital product strategist. Give me 10 digital product ideas for [your niche] that solve a specific problem for [your target audience]. Explain the problem each product solves." 2. Understand your audience "Describe my ideal customer for [product idea]. What are their biggest struggles, questions, goals, and reasons for wanting a solution?" 3. Plan the product "Create a detailed outline for a beginner-friendly [ebook/guide/planner] that helps someone achieve [specific result]. Organize it into clear sections." 4. Write the content "Help me write the content for each section. Use simple language, practical examples, and actionable steps. Avoid vague advice and unnecessary filler." 5. Create useful extras "Suggest worksheets, checklists, templates, or exercises that would make this product more useful to the buyer." 6. Prepare it for Canva "Organize this content into a page-by-page layout for a polished digital product I can design in Canva. Suggest headings, page elements, and visual ideas." 7. Write the sales description "Write a clear product description explaining who this product is for, what problem it solves, what's included, and what the buyer will learn." One important thing: don't just copy and paste the first answer ChatGPT gives you. Review the content, check accuracy, add your own experience, and make sure the finished product genuinely helps someone. AI can speed up the process. The value still comes from the product you create.
